name: kunyu-ecosystem
description: KunYu Studio - Minecraft 模组与整合包可视化开发工具
author: kunyu (睏欤)

scripts.build:win: node scripts/fix-dist-acl.cjs && node scripts/build-observer-agent.cjs && node scripts/run-electron-vite.cjs build && node scripts/assert-out-fresh.cjs && electron-builder --win --publish never -c.electronDist=node_modules/electron/dist && node scripts/verify-dist-freshness.cjs
scripts.release:win: node scripts/fix-dist-acl.cjs && node scripts/build-observer-agent.cjs && node scripts/run-electron-vite.cjs build && node scripts/assert-out-fresh.cjs && electron-builder --win --publish always -c.electronDist=node_modules/electron/dist && node scripts/verify-dist-freshness.cjs
scripts.build:mac: node scripts/build-observer-agent.cjs && node scripts/run-electron-vite.cjs build && node scripts/assert-out-fresh.cjs && electron-builder --mac --publish never && node scripts/verify-dist-freshness.cjs
scripts.release:mac: node scripts/build-observer-agent.cjs && node scripts/run-electron-vite.cjs build && node scripts/assert-out-fresh.cjs && electron-builder --mac --publish always && node scripts/verify-dist-freshness.cjs
scripts.build:linux: node scripts/build-observer-agent.cjs && node scripts/run-electron-vite.cjs build && node scripts/assert-out-fresh.cjs && electron-builder --linux --publish never && node scripts/verify-dist-freshness.cjs
scripts.release:linux: node scripts/build-observer-agent.cjs && node scripts/run-electron-vite.cjs build && node scripts/assert-out-fresh.cjs && electron-builder --linux --publish always && node scripts/verify-dist-freshness.cjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
